translations.idiomatic: On return he judged the Three Departments' fiscal verification bureau and revised the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 累遷尚書刑部員外郎，遂知制誥，遷工部郎中，入翰林為學士，權知開封府。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Justice, then drafter of edicts, director in the Ministry of Works, Hanlin academician, and acting prefect of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly to outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Justice, then drafter of edicts, director in the Ministry of Works, Hanlin academician, and acting prefect of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 忻州地震，偃以為：「地震，陰之盛。

translations.literal: When Xinzhou suffered an earthquake, Yan held that: "Earthquake is the fullness of yin.
translations.idiomatic: When Xinzhou suffered an earthquake, Yan held that: "Earthquake is the fullness of yin.

sentences.zh: 今朝廷政令，不專上出，而後宮外戚，恩澤日蕃，此陽不勝陰之效也。

translations.literal: Today court orders do not issue solely from above, while empresses and maternal kin receive favor daily—this is the effect of yang not overcoming yin.
translations.idiomatic: Today court orders do not issue solely from above, while empresses and maternal kin receive favor daily—this is the effect of yang not overcoming yin.

sentences.zh: 宜選將練師，以防邊塞。」

translations.literal: Generals should be chosen and troops drilled to guard the frontier."
translations.idiomatic: Generals should be chosen and troops drilled to guard the frontier."

sentences.zh: 趙元昊朝貢不至，偃曰：「遽討之，太暴。

translations.literal: When Zhao Yuanhao's tribute missions did not arrive, Yan said: "To attack abruptly is too violent.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Yuanhao's tribute missions did not arrive, Yan said: "To attack abruptly is too violent.

sentences.zh: 宜遣使問其不臣狀，待其辭屈而後加兵。

translations.literal: An envoy should be sent to ask why he is not a subject; wait until his words are refuted and then add troops.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy should be sent to ask why he is not a subject; wait until his words are refuted and then add troops.

sentences.zh: 則其不直者在彼，而王師之出有名矣。」

translations.literal: Then the wrong party is on their side and the royal army's departure has a name."
translations.idiomatic: Then the wrong party is on their side and the royal army's departure has a name."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「戍兵代還，宜如祖宗制，閱其藝後殿次進之。」

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "When garrison troops rotate home, follow ancestral practice—examine their skills in the rear hall and advance them in order."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "When garrison troops rotate home, follow ancestral practice—examine their skills in the rear hall and advance them in order."

sentences.zh: 會有衛卒賂庫吏求揀冬衣，坐繫者三十餘人。

translations.literal: Thereupon palace guards bribed clerks to seek selection of winter clothing; more than thirty were imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon palace guards bribed clerks to seek selection of winter clothing; more than thirty were imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 時八月，霜雪暴至。

translations.literal: It was the eighth month and frost and snow came suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: It was the eighth month and frost and snow came suddenly.

sentences.zh: 偃推《洪範》“急，恒寒若”之咎，請從末 減，奏可。

translations.literal: Yan applied the Great Plan's blame "haste—constant cold like" and asked reduction from the lowest degree; the memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yan applied the Great Plan's blame "haste—constant cold like" and asked reduction from the lowest degree; the memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 西塞用兵，士卒妻子留京師者，犯法當死，帝不忍用刑，或欲以毒置飲食中，令得善死。

translations.literal: When western border troops were deployed, soldiers' wives who remained in the capital and broke the law deserved death; the emperor could not bear to use punishment and some wished to place poison in food and drink so they might die well.
translations.idiomatic: When western border troops were deployed, soldiers' wives who remained in the capital and broke the law deserved death; the emperor could not bear to use punishment and some wished to place poison in food and drink so they might die well.

sentences.zh: 偃極言其不可，帝亦悔而止。

translations.literal: Yan spoke strongly that this could not be done; the emperor also regretted it and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Yan spoke strongly that this could not be done; the emperor also regretted it and stopped.

sentences.zh: 宦人程智誠與三班使臣馮文顯八人抵罪，帝使赦智誠三人，而文顯五人坐如法。

translations.literal: The eunuch Cheng Zhicheng and eight men of the Three-Rank envoy corps including Feng Wenxian were convicted; the emperor wished to pardon Zhicheng and three others while the five including Wenxian would be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Cheng Zhicheng and eight men of the Three-Rank envoy corps including Feng Wenxian were convicted; the emperor wished to pardon Zhicheng and three others while the five including Wenxian would be punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 偃曰：「 恤近遺遠，非政也，況同罪異罰乎？」

translations.literal: Yan said: "Favoring the near and neglecting the far is not government—and moreover, equal guilt with unequal punishment?"
translations.idiomatic: Yan said: "Favoring the near and neglecting the far is not government—and moreover, equal guilt with unequal punishment?"

sentences.zh: 詔並釋之。

translations.literal: An edict released them all.
translations.idiomatic: An edict released them all.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 偃未仕時，家有良田數十頃，既貴，悉以予族人。

translations.literal: Before Yan took office his family had several dozen qing of good farmland; once honored, he gave it all to kinsmen.
translations.idiomatic: Before Yan took office his family had several dozen qing of good farmland; once honored, he gave it all to kinsmen.

sentences.zh: 初，天下職田，無日月之限，而赴官者多以前後為斷。

translations.literal: At first, office land throughout the realm had no limit of days and months, and those taking up posts mostly cut off by before and after.
translations.idiomatic: At first, office land throughout the realm had no limit of days and months, and those taking up posts mostly cut off by before and after.

sentences.zh: 偃請水陸田各限以月，因著為令。

translations.literal: Yan asked that water and land fields each be limited by month, and it was written into regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Yan asked that water and land fields each be limited by month, and it was written into regulation.

sentences.zh: 嘗與謝絳受詔試中書吏，而大臣有以簡屬偃者，偃不敢發視，亟焚之。

translations.literal: He once with Xie Jiang received an edict to test Secretariat clerks, and a great minister sent a note asking a favor of Yan; Yan dared not open it and quickly burned it.
translations.idiomatic: He once with Xie Jiang received an edict to test Secretariat clerks, and a great minister sent a note asking a favor of Yan; Yan dared not open it and quickly burned it.

sentences.zh: 歐陽修始見偃，偃愛其文，召置門下，妻以女。

translations.literal: When Ouyang Xiu first met Yan, Yan loved his writings and summoned him to his gate, giving him his daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: When Ouyang Xiu first met Yan, Yan loved his writings and summoned him to his gate, giving him his daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 偃糾察刑獄，范仲淹尹京，偃數糾其立異不循法者。

translations.literal: Yan investigated criminal cases; Fan Zhongyan was prefect of the capital and Yan repeatedly impeached him for establishing differences and not following law.
translations.idiomatic: Yan investigated criminal cases; Fan Zhongyan was prefect of the capital and Yan repeatedly impeached him for establishing differences and not following law.

sentences.zh: 修方善仲淹，因與偃有隙。

translations.literal: Xiu was then friendly with Zhongyan and therefore had a rift with Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu was then friendly with Zhongyan and therefore had a rift with Yan.

sentences.zh: 子元衡，有學行，能自立，為尚書都官員外郎，並其子茂諶咸早卒。

translations.literal: His son Yuanheng had learning and conduct and could stand on his own, serving as outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Justice; both he and his son Maoqin died young.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yuanheng had learning and conduct and could stand on his own, serving as outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Justice; both he and his son Maoqin died young.

sentences.zh: 偃妻，直史館刁約之妹。

translations.literal: Yan's wife was the younger sister of Diao Yue, compiler in the Academy of History.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's wife was the younger sister of Diao Yue, compiler in the Academy of History.

sentences.zh: 與元衡婦韓、茂諶婦謝皆寡居丹陽，閨門有法，江、淮人至今稱之。

translations.literal: With Yuanheng's wife Han and Maoqin's wife Xie, all were widows dwelling in Danyang; their inner gates had discipline, and people along the Yangzi and Huai still praise them today.
translations.idiomatic: With Yuanheng's wife Han and Maoqin's wife Xie, all were widows dwelling in Danyang; their inner gates had discipline, and people along the Yangzi and Huai still praise them today.

sentences.zh: 柳植，字子春，真州人。

translations.literal: Liu Zhi, style name Zichun, was a native of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhi, courtesy name Zichun, was a native of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 少貧，自奮為學，從祖開頗器之。

translations.literal: Poor in youth, he strove in learning; his uncle by marriage Liu Kai greatly valued him.
translations.idiomatic: Poor in youth, he strove in learning; his uncle by marriage Liu Kai greatly valued him.

sentences.zh: 舉進士甲科，為大理評事、通判滁州。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the top grade and was appointed reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and surveillance commissioner of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the top grade and was appointed reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and surveillance commissioner of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷著作郎、直集賢院、知秀州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to editorial director, direct collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and prefect of Xiu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to editorial director, direct collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and prefect of Xiu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 除三司度支判官，出知宣州。

translations.literal: He was appointed fiscal judge in the Three Departments and went out as prefect of Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed fiscal judge in the Three Departments and went out as prefect of Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 擢修起居注、知制誥。

translations.literal: He was elevated to reviser of the Veritable Records and drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: He was elevated to reviser of the Veritable Records and drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 求知蘇州，徙杭州，累遷尚書工部員外、郎中。

translations.literal: He asked to be prefect of Suzhou, was transferred to Hangzhou, and was promoted repeatedly to outer-court vice-director and director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to be prefect of Suzhou, was transferred to Hangzhou, and was promoted repeatedly to outer-court vice-director and director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 召還，為翰林學士，遷諫議大夫、御史中丞。

translations.literal: Recalled, he became Hanlin academician and was promoted to remonstrance grandee and censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he became Hanlin academician and was promoted to remonstrance grandee and censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 既而以疾辭，改侍讀學士、知鄧州。

translations.literal: Soon he resigned on grounds of illness and was changed to reader-in-waiting and prefect of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he resigned on grounds of illness and was changed to reader-in-waiting and prefect of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷給事中、移潁州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to recipient of edicts and transferred to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to recipient of edicts and transferred to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 先是，張海、郭邈山叛京西，攻掠縣鎮，而光化卒邵興亦率其徒作亂，逐官吏，取庫兵而去。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhang Hai and Guo Yaoshan rebelled in western Jing and attacked counties and towns, while Guanghua soldier Shao Xing also led his comrades in revolt, drove off officials, and took depot weapons and left.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Zhang Hai and Guo Yaoshan rebelled in western Jing and attacked counties and towns, while Guanghua soldier Shao Xing also led his comrades in revolt, drove off officials, and took depot weapons and left.

sentences.zh: 時植領京西安撫使，坐賊發部中不能察，降右諫議大夫、知黃州。

translations.literal: At the time Zhi headed the western Jing pacification commission; because the bandits arose in his jurisdiction without his detecting them, he was demoted to right remonstrance grandee and prefect of Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhi headed the western Jing pacification commission; because the bandits arose in his jurisdiction without his detecting them, he was demoted to right remonstrance grandee and prefect of Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 久之，復其官。

translations.literal: After a long while his office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while his office was restored.

sentences.zh: 坐薦張得一落職，未幾，復其職如故。

translations.literal: For recommending Zhang Deyi he lost office; before long his office was restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: For recommending Zhang Deyi he lost office; before long his office was restored as before.

sentences.zh: 歷知壽、亳、蔡、揚四州，分司西京，遂致仕。

translations.literal: He successively served as prefect of Shou, Bo, Cai, and Yang prefectures, commissioner of the Western Capital branch, and then retired.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as prefect of Shou, Bo, Cai, and Yang prefectures, commissioner of the Western Capital branch, and then retired.

sentences.zh: 累遷吏部侍郎，卒。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly to Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and died.

sentences.zh: 植平居畏慎，寡言笑，所至官舍，蔬果不輒采，家無長物，時稱其廉。

translations.literal: Zhi in ordinary life was cautious and fearful, sparing of words and laughter; at every post he would not casually pick garden fruits and vegetables; his household had no long possessions, and the age called him incorrupt.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi in ordinary life was cautious and fearful, sparing of words and laughter; at every post he would not casually pick garden fruits and vegetables; his household had no long possessions, and the age called him incorrupt.

sentences.zh: 聶冠卿

translations.literal: Nie Guanqing
translations.idiomatic: Nie Guanqing

sentences.zh: 聶冠卿，字長孺，歙州新安人。

translations.literal: Nie Guanqing, style name Changru, was a native of Xin'an in Shezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Guanqing, courtesy name Changru, was a native of Xin'an in Shezhou.

sentences.zh: 五世祖師道，楊行密版奏，號問政先生，鴻臚卿。

translations.literal: His fifth-generation ancestor Shidao was memorialized by Yang Xingmi as Lord of Inquiry into Governance, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: His fifth-generation ancestor Shidao was memorialized by Yang Xingmi as Lord of Inquiry into Governance, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 冠卿舉進士，授連州軍事推官。

translations.literal: Guanqing passed the jinshi examination and was appointed investigating official in Lianzhou military administration.
translations.idiomatic: Guanqing passed the jinshi examination and was appointed investigating official in Lianzhou military administration.

sentences.zh: 楊億愛其文章，於是大臣交薦，召試學士院，校勘館閣書籍。

translations.literal: Yang Yi loved his writings; thereupon great ministers jointly recommended him; he was summoned for trial in the Academy and collated books in the palace collections.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yi loved his writings; thereupon great ministers jointly recommended him; he was summoned for trial in the Academy and collated books in the palace collections.

sentences.zh: 遷大理寺丞，為集賢校理、通判蘄州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to aide in the Court of Judicial Review, collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and surveillance commissioner of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to aide in the Court of Judicial Review, collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and surveillance commissioner of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 坐嘗校《十代興亡論》謬誤落職。

translations.literal: He lost office for once collating the Ten Dynasties Rise and Fall with errors.
translations.idiomatic: He lost office for once collating the Ten Dynasties Rise and Fall with errors.

sentences.zh: 再遷太常博士，復集賢校理。

translations.literal: He was promoted again to erudite in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and restored as collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to erudite in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and restored as collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 言：「天下旬奏獄，雖笞、杖並覆，而徒、流不繫獄者乃不以聞，非所以矜慎刑罰之意。

translations.literal: He said: "Throughout the realm decennial memorial prisons, though flogging and staff are all reviewed, yet exile and penal servitude not held in prison are not reported—this is not the intent of showing mercy in punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "Throughout the realm decennial memorial prisons, though flogging and staff are all reviewed, yet exile and penal servitude not held in prison are not reported—this is not the intent of showing mercy in punishments.

sentences.zh: 請自今罷覆笞、杖罪，自徒以上雖不繫獄，亦奏覆。」

translations.literal: I ask that henceforth review of flogging and staff crimes be ended, and from exile upward, though not held in prison, memorial review also be submitted."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that henceforth review of flogging and staff crimes be ended, and from exile upward, though not held in prison, memorial review also be submitted."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The throne followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne followed this.

sentences.zh: 判登聞鼓院，歷開封府判官、三司鹽鐵度支判官，同修起居注。

translations.literal: He judged the Court of Complaint and Appeal, served successively as judge in the Kaifeng prefectural office and fiscal judge in the Salt and Iron Commission, and jointly revised the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He judged the Court of Complaint and Appeal, served successively as judge in the Kaifeng prefectural office and fiscal judge in the Salt and Iron Commission, and jointly revised the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 累遷尚書工部郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly to director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 初，翰林侍講學士馮元修大樂，命冠卿檢閱事跡。

translations.literal: At first Hanlin lecturer Feng Yuan revised the great music and ordered Guanqing to examine the records.
translations.idiomatic: At first Hanlin lecturer Feng Yuan revised the great music and ordered Guanqing to examine the records.

sentences.zh: 又預撰《景祐廣樂記》，特遷刑部郎中、直集賢院。

translations.literal: He also took part in drafting the Expanded Music Record of the Jingyou era and was specially transferred to director in the Ministry of Justice and direct collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He also took part in drafting the Expanded Music Record of the Jingyou era and was specially transferred to director in the Ministry of Justice and direct collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 以兵部郎中、知制誥判太常禮院，糾察刑獄。

translations.literal: As director in the Ministry of War, drafter of edicts, and judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, he investigated criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: As director in the Ministry of War, drafter of edicts, and judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, he investigated criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 奉使契丹，其主謂曰：「君家先世奉道，子孫固有昌者。」

translations.literal: Sent as envoy to the Khitan, their ruler said to him: "Your family's forebears served the Way; surely descendants will have prosperity."
translations.idiomatic: Sent as envoy to the Khitan, their ruler said to him: "Your family's forebears served the Way; surely descendants will prosper."

sentences.zh: 嘗觀所著《蘄春集》，詞極清麗，因自擊球縱飲，命冠卿賦詩，禮遇甚厚。

translations.literal: He once read Guanqing's collected works Qichun Collection—the language was extremely clear and refined—and therefore while playing ball and drinking freely ordered Guanqing to compose poetry, treating him with great courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: He once read Guanqing's Qichun Collection—the language was extremely refined—and while playing ball and drinking freely ordered Guanqing to compose poetry, treating him with great courtesy.

sentences.zh: 還，同知通進銀臺司、審刑院，入翰林為學士。

translations.literal: On his return he served as vice director of the Office for Transmission of Documents in Silver Terrace and the Court for Review of Punishments, and entered the Hanlin Academy as academician.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he served as vice director of the Office for Transmission of Documents in Silver Terrace and the Court for Review of Punishments, and entered the Hanlin Academy as academician.

sentences.zh: 母亡，起復，判昭文館。

translations.literal: When his mother died he was recalled from mourning and judged the Zhaowen Academy.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he was recalled from mourning and judged the Zhaowen Academy.

sentences.zh: 未幾，兼侍讀學士。

translations.literal: Before long he also served as reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he also served as reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 冠卿每進讀《左氏春秋》，必引尊王黜霸之義以諷。

translations.literal: Whenever Guanqing lectured on the Zuo Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals, he always cited the meaning of honoring the king and dismissing hegemons to admonish.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Guanqing lectured on the Zuo Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals, he always cited the meaning of honoring the king and dismissing hegemons to admonish.

sentences.zh: 一日，墜笏上前，帝憫冠卿喪毀羸瘠，既退，賜禁中湯劑。

translations.literal: One day his tablet fell before the throne; the emperor pitied Guanqing's mourning and emaciation, and after he withdrew bestowed palace medicine.
translations.idiomatic: One day his tablet fell before the throne; the emperor pitied Guanqing's mourning and emaciation, and after he withdrew bestowed palace medicine.

sentences.zh: 未幾，告歸葬親，至揚州卒。

translations.literal: Before long he asked to return and bury his parent; he died at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he asked to return and bury his parent; he died at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔以其弟太常博士世卿通判宣州。

translations.literal: An edict made his younger brother Shiqing, erudite in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, surveillance commissioner of Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made his younger brother Shiqing, erudite in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, surveillance commissioner of Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，世卿監延豐倉，掘地得古磚，有隸書字，半漫滅。

translations.literal: At first Shiqing supervised the Yanfeng granary and digging the ground obtained an ancient brick with clerical script characters, half effaced.
translations.idiomatic: At first Shiqing supervised the Yanfeng granary and digging the ground obtained an ancient brick with clerical script characters, half effaced.

sentences.zh: 其可辨者云：「公先世餌霞棲雲，高尚不仕，累石於江濱。」

translations.literal: What could be made out read: "Your forebears ate cloud mist and dwelt among clouds, lofty and not serving office, piled stones on the river bank."
translations.idiomatic: What could be made out read: "Your forebears ate cloud mist and dwelt among clouds, lofty and not serving office, piled stones on the river bank."

sentences.zh: 又云：「昭王大丞相聶。」

translations.literal: It also read: "Grand Chancellor Nie of King Zhao."
translations.idiomatic: It also read: "Grand Chancellor Nie of King Zhao."

sentences.zh: 又云：「水龍夜號，夕雞駭飛。

translations.literal: It also read: "The water dragon cried at night, the evening cock flew in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: It also read: "The water dragon cried at night, the evening cock flew in alarm.

sentences.zh: 其年九月十二日卒，年五十有五。」

translations.literal: In that year on the twelfth day of the ninth month he died, age fifty-five."
translations.idiomatic: In that year on the twelfth day of the ninth month he died, age fifty-five."

sentences.zh: 冠卿始見而惡之，至是，校所卒歲月及其享年，無少異者。

translations.literal: When Guanqing first saw it he was displeased; when this came to pass, comparing the year and month of death and his span of years, there was not the slightest difference.
translations.idiomatic: When Guanqing first saw it he was displeased; when this came to pass, comparing the year and month of death and his span of years, there was not the slightest difference.

sentences.zh: 冠卿嗜學好古，手未嘗釋卷，尤工詩，有《蘄春集》十卷。

translations.literal: Guanqing loved learning and antiquity and never put down his books; he was especially skilled in poetry and had ten fascicles of the Qichun Collection.
translations.idiomatic: Guanqing loved learning and antiquity and never put down his books; he was especially skilled in poetry and had ten juan of the Qichun Collection.

sentences.zh: 論曰：學士大夫異於眾人者，以操行修爾。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Scholar-officials differ from the multitude in that they cultivate conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Scholar-officials differ from the multitude in that they cultivate conduct.

sentences.zh: 《詩》曰：「靡不有初，鮮克有終。」

translations.literal: The Odes says: "All have a beginning, few can have an end."
translations.idiomatic: The Odes says: "All have a beginning, few can have an end."

sentences.zh: 君子不可不慎也。

translations.literal: The gentleman cannot but be careful.
translations.idiomatic: The gentleman cannot but be careful.

sentences.zh: 禹錫迂陋，不知止足之戒，取譏當世。

translations.literal: Yu Xi was pedantic and vulgar, ignorant of the warning against not knowing when to stop, and drew ridicule in his age.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xi was pedantic and vulgar, ignorant of the warning against not knowing when to stop, and drew ridicule in his age.

sentences.zh: 紳急進喜傾。

translations.literal: Shen was eager to advance and delighted in overthrowing others.
translations.idiomatic: Shen was eager to advance and delighted in overthrowing others.

sentences.zh: 洙阿諛附會，晚節汙變，卒忘平生之學。

translations.literal: Zhu flattered and attached himself to factions; in his later years his conduct was stained and changed, and in the end he forgot the learning of his lifetime.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu flattered and attached himself to factions; in his later years his conduct was stained and changed, and in the end he forgot the learning of his lifetime.

sentences.zh: 偃之恬正，植之廉介，冠卿之雅尚，其列侍從，庶亡愧焉。

translations.literal: Yan's tranquil rectitude, Zhi's incorrupt integrity, and Guanqing's elegant esteem—as they stood in attendance on the throne, they could mostly be without shame.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's tranquil rectitude, Zhi's incorrupt integrity, and Guanqing's elegant esteem—as they stood in attendance on the throne, they could mostly be without shame.

sentences.zh: 馮元，字道宗。

translations.literal: Feng Yuan, style name Daozong.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yuan, courtesy name Daozong.

sentences.zh: 高祖禧，唐末官廣州，以術數仕劉氏。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Xi in late Tang served in Guangzhou and by numerology served the Liu house.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Xi in late Tang served in Guangzhou and by numerology served the Liu house.

sentences.zh: 傳三世至父邴，廣南平，入朝為保章正。

translations.literal: The line passed three generations to his father Bing; when Lingnan was pacified he entered court as Director of Astral Observations.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed three generations to his father Bing; when Lingnan was pacified he entered court as Director of Astral Observations.

sentences.zh: 元幼從崔頤正、孫奭為《五經》大義，與樂安孫質、吳陸參、譙夏侯圭善，群居講學，或達旦不寢，號「四友」。

translations.literal: Yuan in youth followed Cui Yizheng and Sun Shi in the Great Meaning of the Five Classics, and was friendly with Sun Zhi of Le'an, Wu Lucan, and Xiahou Gui of Qiao; they gathered to lecture and sometimes did not sleep until dawn, and were called the "Four Friends."
translations.idiomatic: Yuan in youth followed Cui Yizheng and Sun Shi in the Great Meaning of the Five Classics, and was friendly with Sun Zhi of Le'an, Wu Lucan, and Xiahou Gui of Qiao; they gathered to lecture and sometimes did not sleep until dawn, and were called the "Four Friends."

sentences.zh: 進士中第，授江陰尉。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was appointed aide in Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and was appointed aide in Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 時詔流內銓取明經者補學官，元自薦通《五經》。

translations.literal: At that time an edict ordered the Inner Circulation Board to take men who had passed the classics examination to fill academic posts; Yuan recommended himself as mastering the Five Classics.
translations.idiomatic: At that time an edict ordered the Inner Circulation Board to take men who had passed the classics examination to fill academic posts; Yuan recommended himself as mastering the Five Classics.

sentences.zh: 謝泌笑曰：「古治一經，或至皓首，子尚少，能盡通邪？」

translations.literal: Xie Mi laughed and said: "In antiquity to master one classic one might study until white hair; you are still young—can you master them all?"
translations.idiomatic: Xie Mi laughed and said: "In antiquity to master one classic one might study until white hair; you are still young—can you master them all?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「達者一以貫之。」

translations.literal: He answered: "The penetrating person comprehends all in one."
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "The penetrating person comprehends all in one."

sentences.zh: 更問疑義，辨析無滯。

translations.literal: Further questioned on doubtful points, he analyzed without hesitation.
translations.idiomatic: Further questioned on doubtful points, he analyzed without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 補國子監講書，遷大理評事，擢崇文院檢討兼國子監直講。

translations.literal: He was appointed lecturer in the Directorate of Education, transferred to reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review, and elevated to reviser in the Chongwen Academy with concurrent direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed lecturer in the Directorate of Education, transferred to reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review, and elevated to reviser in the Chongwen Academy with concurrent direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 王旦聞其名，嘗令說《論語》、《老子》，群子弟侍聽，因薦之。

translations.literal: Wang Dan heard his name and once had him expound the Analects and Laozi while the clan youths attended and listened, and therefore recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dan heard his name and once had him expound the Analects and Laozi while the clan youths attended and listened, and therefore recommended him.

sentences.zh: 真宗試進士殿中，召元講《易》。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong tested jinshi in the palace hall and summoned Yuan to lecture on the Changes.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong tested jinshi in the palace hall and summoned Yuan to lecture on the Changes.

sentences.zh: 元進說曰：「地天為《泰》者，以天地之氣交也。

translations.literal: Yuan advanced and explained: "Heaven and Earth as Tai means the qi of Heaven and Earth interact.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan advanced and explained: "Heaven and Earth as Tai means the qi of Heaven and Earth interact.

sentences.zh: 君道至尊，臣道至卑，惟上下相與，則可以輔相天地，財成萬化。」

translations.literal: The way of the ruler is supremely honored and the way of the minister supremely low—only when above and below join can they assist Heaven and Earth and complete the myriad transformations."
translations.idiomatic: The way of the ruler is supremely honored and the way of the minister supremely low—only when above and below join can they assist Heaven and Earth and complete the myriad transformations."

sentences.zh: 帝悅。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷太子中允、直龍圖閣，詔預內朝，直龍圖閣預內朝自此始。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Vice Director in the Crown Prince's household and direct appointment in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion; an edict placed him in the inner court—direct appointment in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion in the inner court began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to Vice Director in the Crown Prince's household and direct appointment in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion; an edict placed him in the inner court—direct appointment in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion in the inner court began from this.

sentences.zh: 天禧初，數與查道、李虛己、李行簡入講《易》於宣和門北閣。

translations.literal: In the early Tianxi era he several times with Zha Dao, Li Xuji, and Li Xingjian entered to lecture on the Changes in the northern pavilion of the Xuanhe Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Tianxi era he several times with Zha Dao, Li Xuji, and Li Xingjian entered to lecture on the Changes in the northern pavilion of the Xuanhe Gate.

sentences.zh: 遷太常丞兼判禮部、吏部南曹。

translations.literal: He was transferred to aide in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with concurrent judge in the Ministry of Rites and southern bureau of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to aide in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices with concurrent judge in the Ministry of Rites and southern bureau of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 皇子為壽春郡王，王旦又薦元宜講經資善堂。

translations.literal: The imperial son was Prince of Shouchun; Wang Dan again recommended Yuan as fit to lecture in the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial son was Prince of Shouchun; Wang Dan again recommended Yuan as fit to lecture in the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.

sentences.zh: 帝以元少，更用崔遵度。

translations.literal: The emperor thought Yuan young and instead used Cui Zundu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thought Yuan young and instead used Cui Zundu.

sentences.zh: 會遵度卒，擢左正言兼太子右諭德。

translations.literal: When Zundu died, Yuan was elevated to left rectifier of speech with concurrent mentor of the crown prince's right establishment.
translations.idiomatic: When Zundu died, Yuan was elevated to left rectifier of speech with concurrent mentor of the crown prince's right establishment.

sentences.zh: 仁宗即位，遷戶部員外郎，為直學士兼侍講。

translations.literal: When Emperor Renzong acceded, he was transferred to outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Revenue and made direct academician with concurrent lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Renzong acceded, he was transferred to outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Revenue and made direct academician with concurrent lecturer.

sentences.zh: 與孫奭以經術並進講論，自是仁宗益嚮學。

translations.literal: With Sun Shi he advanced by classical learning together in lecture and discussion; from this Renzong increasingly turned to learning.
translations.idiomatic: With Sun Shi he advanced by classical learning together in lecture and discussion; from this Renzong increasingly turned to learning.

sentences.zh: 歷會靈觀副使、知通進銀臺司、判登聞檢院、同判國子監。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice commissioner of the Hall of Numina, director of the Office for Transmission of Documents in Silver Terrace, judge of the Court of Complaint and Inspection, and co-superintendent of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as vice commissioner of the Hall of Numina, director of the Office for Transmission of Documents in Silver Terrace, judge of the Court of Complaint and Inspection, and co-superintendent of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 故事，國子監多宿儒典領，後頗用公卿子弟，任均管庫。

translations.literal: By precedent the Directorate of Education was mostly led by senior Confucians; later the sons of dukes and ministers were much used and all managed storehouses equally.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the Directorate of Education was mostly led by senior Confucians; later the sons of dukes and ministers were much used and all managed storehouses equally.

sentences.zh: 及奭、元並命，士議悅服。

translations.literal: When Shi and Yuan were both appointed, scholarly opinion was pleased and convinced.
translations.idiomatic: When Shi and Yuan were both appointed, scholarly opinion was pleased and convinced.

sentences.zh: 同知貢舉，進龍圖閣學士，預修《三朝正史》。

translations.literal: As co-director of the examinations he was advanced to academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and took part in compiling the Veritable Records of the Three Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: As co-director of the examinations he was advanced to academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and took part in compiling the Veritable Records of the Three Reigns.

sentences.zh: 為翰林學士、判都省三班院、史館修撰、判流內銓兼群牧使，四遷給事中。

translations.literal: He became Hanlin academician, judged the Secretariat's Three-Rank Court, Academy compiler, judge of the Inner Circulation Board with concurrent commissioner of the Herds, and was promoted four times to recipient of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: He became Hanlin academician, judged the Secretariat's Three-Rank Court, Academy compiler, judge of the Inner Circulation Board with concurrent commissioner of the Herds, and was promoted four times to recipient of edicts.

sentences.zh: 元性簡厚，不治聲名，非慶吊未嘗過謁二府。

translations.literal: Yuan's nature was simple and generous; he did not pursue fame; except for congratulations and condolences he never visited the Two Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan's nature was simple and generous; he did not pursue fame; except for congratulations and condolences he never visited the Two Offices.

sentences.zh: 執親喪，自括髮至祥練，皆案禮變服，不為世俗齋薦，遇祭日，與門生對坐，誦說《孝經》而已。

translations.literal: When observing mourning for a parent, from cutting the hair to the end of the second-year mourning he followed ritual in changing garments and did not perform popular Buddhist fasting; on sacrifice days he sat facing his students and recited only the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: When observing mourning for a parent, from cutting the hair to the end of the second-year mourning he followed ritual in changing garments and did not perform popular Buddhist fasting; on sacrifice days he sat facing his students and recited only the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: 多識古今臺閣品式之事，尤精《易》。

translations.literal: He knew much of ancient and modern matters of terrace and pavilion grades and forms, and was especially expert in the Changes.
translations.idiomatic: He knew much of ancient and modern matters of terrace and pavilion grades and forms, and was especially expert in the Changes.

sentences.zh: 初，七歲，方讀《易》，每夜夢異人，以紺蓮華與元吞之，且曰：「善讀此，後必貴顯。」

translations.literal: At first, at age seven, when reading the Changes, each night he dreamed a strange man gave him an indigo lotus to swallow and said: "Read this well and later you will certainly be honored."
translations.idiomatic: At first, at age seven, when reading the Changes, each night he dreamed a strange man gave him an indigo lotus to swallow and said: "Read this well and later you will certainly be honored."

sentences.zh: 元且老，率三日一誦《易》。

translations.literal: When Yuan was old he still recited the Changes every three days on average.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan was old he still recited the Changes every three days on average.

sentences.zh: 無子，以兄之子譓為後。

translations.literal: Having no son, he took his elder brother's son Hui as heir.
translations.idiomatic: Having no son, he took his elder brother's son Hui as heir.

sentences.zh: 趙師民

translations.literal: Zhao Shimin
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shimin

sentences.zh: 趙師民，字周翰，青州臨淄人。

translations.literal: Zhao Shimin, style name Zhouhan, was a native of Linzi in Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shimin, courtesy name Zhouhan, was a native of Linzi in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九歲能屬文，舉進士第，孫奭辟兗州說書，領諸城主簿。

translations.literal: At age nine he could compose prose; he passed the jinshi examination; Sun Shi summoned him as lecturer in Yanzhou and he headed Zhucheng chief clerk.
translations.idiomatic: At age nine he could compose prose; he passed the jinshi examination; Sun Shi summoned him as lecturer in Yanzhou and he headed Zhucheng chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 師民學問精博，奭自以為不及。

translations.literal: Shimin's learning was refined and broad; Shi felt himself inferior.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin's learning was refined and broad; Shi felt himself inferior.

sentences.zh: 夏竦尤所奇重，稱為「盛德君子」，論其文行，願回兩子恩，授以京秩。

translations.literal: Xia Song especially valued him, calling him a "gentleman of abundant virtue," and discussing his literary conduct wished to exchange the favor shown two sons and grant him capital rank.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Song especially valued him, calling him a "gentleman of abundant virtue," and discussing his literary conduct wished to exchange the favor shown two sons and grant him capital rank.

sentences.zh: 除齊州推官、青州教授，更天平軍節度推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed investigating official in Qizhou and professor in Qingzhou, then investigating official in the Tianping military commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed investigating official in Qizhou and professor in Qingzhou, then investigating official in the Tianping military commission.

sentences.zh: 年五十來京師，近臣張觀、宋郊、王堯臣、龐籍、韓琦、明鎬列薦，為國子監直講，兼潤、冀二王宮教授。

translations.literal: At age fifty he came to the capital; close ministers Zhang Guan, Song Jiao, Wang Yao Chen, Pang Ji, Han Qi, and Ming Hao jointly recommended him as direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education with concurrent professor in the Run and Ji princely establishments.
translations.idiomatic: At age fifty he came to the capital; close ministers Zhang Guan, Song Jiao, Wang Yao Chen, Pang Ji, Han Qi, and Ming Hao jointly recommended him as direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education with concurrent professor in the Run and Ji princely establishments.

sentences.zh: 改著作佐郎、宗正寺主簿，加崇文院檢討、崇政殿說書，遷宗正丞。

translations.literal: He was changed to editorial assistant and registrar in the Court of the Imperial Clan, added reviser in the Chongwen Academy and lecturer in the Chongzheng Hall, and transferred to vice-director in the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to editorial assistant and registrar in the Court of the Imperial Clan, added reviser in the Chongwen Academy and lecturer in the Chongzheng Hall, and transferred to vice-director in the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 會趙元昊反，罷進講。

translations.literal: When Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, lectures were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, lectures were suspended.

sentences.zh: 師民上書陳十五事：一曰諮輔相，二曰命將帥，三曰柬侍從，四曰擇守宰，五曰治軍旅，六曰修邊防，七曰求諫諍，八曰延講誦，九曰革貢舉，十曰久官政，十一曰謹財用，十二曰不遺年，十三曰容誹謗，十四曰除忌諱，十五曰慎出令。

translations.literal: Shimin memorialized setting forth fifteen matters: first, consult chief ministers; second, appoint generals; third, select attendants; fourth, choose prefects and magistrates; fifth, regulate the army; sixth, repair frontier defense; seventh, seek remonstrance; eighth, extend lecture and recitation; ninth, reform examinations; tenth, long tenure in office; eleventh, be careful with finances; twelfth, do not neglect the aged; thirteenth, tolerate slander; fourteenth, remove taboos; fifteenth, be careful in issuing orders.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin memorialized setting forth fifteen matters: first, consult chief ministers; second, appoint generals; third, select attendants; fourth, choose prefects and magistrates; fifth, regulate the army; sixth, repair frontier defense; seventh, seek remonstrance; eighth, extend lecture and recitation; ninth, reform examinations; tenth, long tenure in office; eleventh, be careful with finances; twelfth, do not neglect the aged; thirteenth, tolerate slander; fourteenth, remove taboos; fifteenth, be careful in issuing orders.

sentences.zh: 因獻《勸講箴》。

translations.literal: He also presented the Admonition to Encourage Lectures.
translations.idiomatic: He also presented the Admonition to Encourage Lectures.

sentences.zh: 明年春，帝遂御迎陽門，召近臣觀圖畫，復命講讀經史。

translations.literal: The next spring the emperor then went to the Yingyang Gate, summoned close ministers to view paintings, and again ordered lecture and reading of the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring the emperor then went to the Yingyang Gate, summoned close ministers to view paintings, and again ordered lecture and reading of the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 師民見朝廷厭兵，屈意以招元昊，內不能平。

translations.literal: Shimin saw the court weary of war and bending its intent to win over Yuanhao; inwardly he could not be at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin saw the court weary of war and bending its intent to win over Yuanhao; inwardly he could not be at peace.

sentences.zh: 乃上言請任方面，以圖報效。

translations.literal: He therefore memorialized asking to hold a regional post to repay service.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore memorialized asking to hold a regional post to repay service.

sentences.zh: 遷天章章閣侍講、同知貢舉，進待制、同判宗正寺。

translations.literal: He was transferred to lecturer in the Tianzhang Pavilion and co-director of the examinations, advanced to awaiting edict and co-judge of the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to lecturer in the Tianzhang Pavilion and co-director of the examinations, advanced to awaiting edict and co-judge of the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 嘗講《詩》「 如彼泉流」，曰：「水之初出，喻王政之發。

translations.literal: He once lectured on the Odes' "like that spring's flow" and said: "Water's first emergence symbolizes the issuing of royal government.
translations.idiomatic: He once lectured on the Odes' "like that spring's flow" and said: "Water's first emergence symbolizes the issuing of royal government.

sentences.zh: 順行則通，通故清潔；

translations.literal: Flowing straight it passes; passing it is clear and clean;
translations.idiomatic: Flowing straight it passes; passing it is clear and clean;

sentences.zh: 逆亂則壅，壅故濁敗。

translations.literal: turned back in disorder it is blocked; blocked it is muddy and ruined.
translations.idiomatic: turned back in disorder it is blocked; blocked it is muddy and ruined.

sentences.zh: 賢人用，則王政通而世清平；

translations.literal: When worthy men are used, royal government passes and the age is clear and peaceful;
translations.idiomatic: When worthy men are used, royal government passes and the age is clear and peaceful;

sentences.zh: 邪人進，則王澤壅而世濁敗。

translations.literal: when depraved men advance, royal favor is blocked and the age is muddy and ruined.
translations.idiomatic: when depraved men advance, royal favor is blocked and the age is muddy and ruined.

sentences.zh: 幽王失道，用邪絀正，正不勝邪，雖有善人，不能為治，亦將相牽而淪於汙濁也。」

translations.literal: King You lost the Way, used the depraved and dismissed the upright; the upright did not overcome the depraved; though there were good men they could not govern, and would also be dragged together into mire and filth."
translations.idiomatic: King You lost the Way, used the depraved and dismissed the upright; the upright did not overcome the depraved; though there were good men they could not govern, and would also be dragged together into mire and filth."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「水何以喻政？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Why use water to symbolize government?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Why use water to symbolize government?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「水者，順行而潤下，利萬物，故以喻政，此於比興，義最大。」

translations.literal: He answered: "Water flows straight and moistens below, benefiting the myriad things—therefore it symbolizes government; among comparisons this meaning is greatest."
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "Water flows straight and moistens below, benefiting the myriad things—therefore it symbolizes government; among comparisons this meaning is greatest."

sentences.zh: 後講《論語》，問「修文德」，曰：「文者，經天緯地之總稱。

translations.literal: Later lecturing on the Analects, he was asked about "cultivate civil virtue" and said: "Culture is the general term for ordering Heaven and setting Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Later lecturing on the Analects, he was asked about "cultivate civil virtue" and said: "Culture is the general term for ordering Heaven and setting Earth.

sentences.zh: 君人之道，撫之以仁，制之以義，接之以禮，講之以信，皆是。」

translations.literal: The way of ruling men—soothing with benevolence, regulating with righteousness, receiving with ritual, explaining with trust—all are this."
translations.idiomatic: The way of ruling men—soothing with benevolence, regulating with righteousness, receiving with ritual, explaining with trust—all are this."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「然其所先者，無若信也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Yet of these, none surpasses trust."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Yet of these, none surpasses trust."

sentences.zh: 曰：「信者，天下之大本，仁義禮樂，皆必由之，此實至道之要。」

translations.literal: He said: "Trust is the great root under Heaven; benevolence, righteousness, ritual, and music all must pass through it—this is truly the essentials of the utmost Way."
translations.idiomatic: He said: "Trust is the great root under Heaven; benevolence, righteousness, ritual, and music all must pass through it—this is truly the essentials of the utmost Way."

sentences.zh: 復問「鑽燧改火」，曰：「古之聖王，舉動必順天時，所以四時變，火隨木色。

translations.literal: Asked again about "drilling fire and changing fire," he said: "The sage kings of antiquity in every movement followed Heaven's seasons; therefore the four seasons change and fire follows the color of wood.
translations.idiomatic: Asked again about "drilling fire and changing fire," he said: "The sage kings of antiquity in every movement followed Heaven's seasons; therefore the four seasons change and fire follows the color of wood.

sentences.zh: 近世漸務苟簡，以為非治具而遂廢之，至其萬事皆不如古。」

translations.literal: In recent times people have gradually pursued what is convenient and simple, thinking these are not instruments of government and therefore abandoning them—so that in the myriad affairs nothing is as in antiquity."
translations.idiomatic: In recent times people have gradually pursued what is convenient and simple, thinking these are not instruments of government and therefore abandoning them—so that in the myriad affairs nothing is as in antiquity."

sentences.zh: 又問：「子夏、子張所言交道孰勝？」

translations.literal: Asked again: "Between what Zixia and Zizhang said about friendship, which is superior?"
translations.idiomatic: Asked again: "Between what Zixia and Zizhang said about friendship, which is superior?"

sentences.zh: 曰：「聖哲之道，含覆廣大，與天地參。

translations.literal: He said: "The sage's Way embraces and covers, vast as Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "The sage's Way embraces and covers, vast as Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 善者有以進德，惡者俾之改行。

translations.literal: For the good there is means to advance virtue; for the evil there is means to make them change conduct.
translations.idiomatic: For the good there is means to advance virtue; for the evil there is means to make them change conduct.

sentences.zh: 子張之言為優。」

translations.literal: Zizhang's words are superior."
translations.idiomatic: Zizhang's words are superior."

sentences.zh: 他日讀《漢記》，問長安城，眾莫能知，共推師民。

translations.literal: Another day reading the Han Records, he was asked about Chang'an city; none could answer and all pushed Shimin.
translations.idiomatic: Another day reading the Han Records, he was asked about Chang'an city; none could answer and all pushed Shimin.

sentences.zh: 因陳自古都雍年世，舊址所在，若畫諸掌。

translations.literal: He therefore set forth from antiquity the years of capitals at Yong and the old sites, as if drawn on the palm.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore set forth from antiquity the years of capitals at Yong and the old sites, as if drawn on the palm.

sentences.zh: 帝悅曰：「何其所記如此！」

translations.literal: The emperor said with pleasure: "How does he record thus!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said with pleasure: "How does he record thus!"

sentences.zh: 在經筵十餘年，甚見器異。

translations.literal: In the classics lecture hall more than ten years, he was greatly valued and distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In the classics lecture hall more than ten years, he was greatly valued and distinguished.

sentences.zh: 嘗盛夏屬疾家居，帝飛白書團扇為「和平」字，賜以寄意。

translations.literal: Once in midsummer he was ill at home; the emperor wrote the characters "peace" in flying white on a round fan and bestowed it to convey his intent.
translations.idiomatic: Once in midsummer he was ill at home; the emperor wrote the characters "peace" in flying white on a round fan and bestowed it to convey his intent.

sentences.zh: 累請補郡，除龍圖閣直學士、知耀州。

translations.literal: Repeatedly he asked to fill a prefecture and was appointed direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and prefect of Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly he asked to fill a prefecture and was appointed direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and prefect of Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 帝自寫詩寵行，目以「儒林舊德」。

translations.literal: The emperor himself wrote a poem to honor his departure, styling him "old virtue of the Confucian forest."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor himself wrote a poem to honor his departure, styling him "old virtue of the Confucian forest."

sentences.zh: 將行，上疏曰：

translations.literal: About to depart, he submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: About to depart, he submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 「近睹太陽食於正朔，此雖陰陽之事，亦慮是天意欲以感動聖心。

translations.literal: "Recently I observed a solar eclipse at the new moon—though this is a matter of yin and yang, I also fear Heaven's intent wishes to move the sage heart.
translations.idiomatic: "Recently I observed a solar eclipse at the new moon—though this is a matter of yin and yang, I also fear Heaven's intent wishes to move the sage heart.

sentences.zh: 臣非瞽史，不知天道，但率愚意言之。

translations.literal: I am not a blind musician or clerk and do not know Heaven's Way, but speak from foolish opinion alone.
translations.idiomatic: I am not a blind musician or clerk and do not know Heaven's Way, but speak from foolish opinion alone.

sentences.zh: 其月在亥，亥為水，水為正陰。

translations.literal: The month is in hai; hai is water, and water is the true yin.
translations.idiomatic: The month is in hai; hai is water, and water is the true yin.

sentences.zh: 其日在丙，丙為正陽。

translations.literal: The day is in bing; bing is the true yang.
translations.idiomatic: The day is in bing; bing is the true yang.

sentences.zh: 月掩日，陰侵陽，下蔽上之象也。

translations.literal: The moon eclipsing the sun is yin invading yang—the image of below obscuring above.
translations.idiomatic: The moon eclipsing the sun is yin invading yang—the image of below obscuring above.

sentences.zh: 《詩》曰：『十月之交，朔日辛卯。』

translations.literal: The Odes says: 'In the tenth month's intercourse, on the new moon day xinmao.'
translations.idiomatic: The Odes says: 'In the tenth month's intercourse, on the new moon day xinmao.'

sentences.zh: 又曰：『彼月而微，此日而微。』

translations.literal: It also says: 'That moon was dim, this sun was dim.'
translations.idiomatic: It also says: 'That moon was dim, this sun was dim.'

sentences.zh: 謂以陰奸陽，失其敘也。

translations.literal: This speaks of yin harming yang and losing proper order.
translations.idiomatic: This speaks of yin harming yang and losing proper order.

sentences.zh: 又曰：『百川沸騰，山塚崒崩。

translations.literal: It also says: 'A hundred streams boil and surge, mountain tumuli crumble and fall.'
translations.idiomatic: It also says: 'A hundred streams boil and surge, mountain tumuli crumble and fall.'

sentences.zh: 高岸為谷，深谷為陵。』

translations.literal: High banks become valleys, deep valleys become hills.
translations.idiomatic: High banks become valleys, deep valleys become hills.

sentences.zh: 謂下陵上，侵其權也。

translations.literal: This speaks of below overthrowing above and encroaching on its authority.
translations.idiomatic: This speaks of below overthrowing above and encroaching on its authority.

sentences.zh: 又曰：『皇父卿士，番惟司徒。

translations.literal: It also says: 'Grandfather the minister, Fan is sole Minister of Education.'
translations.idiomatic: It also says: 'Grandfather the minister, Fan is sole Minister of Education.'

sentences.zh: 家伯維宰，中允膳夫。

translations.literal: Jia Bo is the steward, Zhong Yun is the provisioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Bo is the steward, Zhong Yun is the provisioner.

sentences.zh: 聚子內史，蹶維趣馬，楀維師氏。』

translations.literal: Juzi the recorder, Jue is sole master of horses, Yu is sole commander of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: Juzi the recorder, Jue is sole master of horses, Yu is sole commander of the guard.

sentences.zh: 謂大小之臣，有不得其人者也。

translations.literal: This speaks of great and small ministers among whom some were not the right men.
translations.idiomatic: This speaks of great and small ministers among whom some were not the right men.

sentences.zh: 宗周之間，時王失德。

translations.literal: Between the Zhou capitals, the king at the time lost virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Zhou capitals, the king at the time lost virtue.

sentences.zh: 今而引喻，蓋事有所譬，固當不諱。

translations.literal: Now in drawing analogy, there is surely something to which matters compare—one should indeed not shrink from speaking.
translations.idiomatic: Now in drawing analogy, there is surely something to which matters compare—one should indeed not shrink from speaking.

sentences.zh: 凡天之示象，由人君有失，不然，則下蔽其上。

translations.literal: Whenever Heaven displays omens, it is because the ruler has faults; otherwise it is that below obscures above.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Heaven displays omens, it is because the ruler has faults; otherwise it is that below obscures above.

sentences.zh: 古人君之失，不過暴虐怠慢，奢侈縱放，不師古始。

translations.literal: The faults of rulers of antiquity were nothing beyond cruelty, sloth, extravagance, indulgence, and not taking antiquity as teacher.
translations.idiomatic: The faults of rulers of antiquity were nothing beyond cruelty, sloth, extravagance, indulgence, and not taking antiquity as teacher.

sentences.zh: 舍是，何失道之有？

translations.literal: Apart from these, what loss of the Way could there be?
translations.idiomatic: Apart from these, what loss of the Way could there be?

sentences.zh: 今聖心慈仁恭勤，儉約自檢，動循典禮，如此自非下蒙上、邪撓正，使主恩不下究，而誰之咎歟？

translations.literal: Now the sage heart is benevolent, respectful, and diligent, frugal and self-restrained, moving according to ritual and precedent—such being the case, if it is not that below obscures above and the depraved bend the upright, causing the ruler's grace not to reach below, whose fault is it?
translations.idiomatic: Now the sage heart is benevolent, respectful, and diligent, frugal and self-restrained, moving according to ritual and precedent—if it is not that below obscures above and the depraved bend the upright, causing the ruler's grace not to reach below, whose fault is it?

sentences.zh: 望陛下朝夕諮於丞弼心膂之臣，洎左右近侍耳目之官。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty morning and evening consult the chief ministers who are the heart and backbone, down to the close attendants who are eyes and ears.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty morning and evening consult the chief ministers who are the heart and backbone, down to the close attendants who are eyes and ears.

sentences.zh: 其忠而純者，與之慎柬內外百執事及州縣牧宰，使主恩究於下，不為群邪所蔽塞，則億兆之幸也。」

translations.literal: Those who are loyal and pure—with them carefully choose inner and outer hundred officials and prefectural and county shepherds and magistrates, so that the ruler's grace reaches below and is not blocked by the crowd of depraved—then the myriad people will be fortunate."
translations.idiomatic: Those who are loyal and pure—with them carefully choose inner and outer hundred officials and prefectural and county shepherds and magistrates, so that the ruler's grace reaches below and is not blocked by the crowd of depraved—then the myriad people will be fortunate."

sentences.zh: 三遷刑部郎中，復領宗正，卒。

translations.literal: He was promoted three times to director in the Ministry of Justice, again headed the Court of the Imperial Clan, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted three times to director in the Ministry of Justice, again headed the Court of the Imperial Clan, and died.

sentences.zh: 師民淳靜剛敏，舉止凝重。

translations.literal: Shimin was pure, tranquil, firm, and keen; his bearing was grave and weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Shimin was pure, tranquil, firm, and keen; his bearing was grave and weighty.

sentences.zh: 幼喪父，哀感，不畜婢妾，年四十四始婚。

translations.literal: He lost his father in youth and was moved by grief; he kept no concubines and did not marry until age forty-four.
translations.idiomatic: He lost his father in youth and was moved by grief; he kept no concubines and did not marry until age forty-four.

sentences.zh: 志尚清遠，專以讀書為事。

translations.literal: His aim was lofty and remote; he devoted himself solely to reading books.
translations.idiomatic: His aim was lofty and remote; he devoted himself solely to reading books.

sentences.zh: 性極慈恕，勤於吏治，政有惠愛。

translations.literal: His nature was extremely merciful and forgiving; he was diligent in governing and his administration had kindness and love.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was extremely merciful and forgiving; he was diligent in governing and his administration had kindness and love.

sentences.zh: 嘗奏蠲陝西旱租。

translations.literal: He once memorialized to remit drought rents in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He once memorialized to remit drought rents in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 又欲論榷酤諸獘敝，會仁宗不豫而止。

translations.literal: He also wished to discuss the abuses of monopoly wine sales but stopped when Emperor Renzong fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: He also wished to discuss the abuses of monopoly wine sales but stopped when Emperor Renzong fell ill.

sentences.zh: 常患近世官失其守，作《正官名》，議多不載。

translations.literal: He often grieved that in recent times officials lost their proper duties and composed Rectifying Official Titles, but most of the discussion was not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: He often grieved that in recent times officials lost their proper duties and composed Rectifying Official Titles, but most of the discussion was not recorded.

sentences.zh: 有集三十卷。

translations.literal: He had a collected works in thirty fascicles.
translations.idiomatic: He had collected works in thirty juan.

sentences.zh: 子彥若，試中書舍人。

translations.literal: His son Yanruo passed the examination for Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yanruo passed the examination for Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 張錫，字貺之，其先京兆人。

translations.literal: Zhang Xi, style name Changzhi, his ancestors were natives of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xi, courtesy name Changzhi, his ancestors were natives of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 曾祖山甫，嘗從唐僖宗入蜀，蜀平，徙家漢陽。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Shanfu once followed Emperor Xizong of Tang into Shu; when Shu was pacified the family moved to Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Shanfu once followed Emperor Xizong of Tang into Shu; when Shu was pacified the family moved to Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 錫進士甲科，為試秘書省校書郎、知南昌縣。

translations.literal: Xi passed the jinshi examination in the top grade and served as probationary collator in the Secretariat and magistrate of Nanchang County.
translations.idiomatic: Xi passed the jinshi examination in the top grade and served as probationary collator in the Secretariat and magistrate of Nanchang County.

sentences.zh: 遷著作郎、知新州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to editorial director and prefect of Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to editorial director and prefect of Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初建學於州，自是人始知學。

translations.literal: When schools were first established in the prefecture, from this people began to know learning.
translations.idiomatic: When schools were first established in the prefecture, from this people began to know learning.

sentences.zh: 再遷太常博士、監染院。

translations.literal: He was promoted again to erudite in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and supervisor of the dye works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to erudite in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and supervisor of the dye works.

sentences.zh: 詔選能吏治畿縣，乃以錫知東明。

translations.literal: An edict selected capable officials to govern capital counties, and Xi was therefore made magistrate of Dongming.
translations.idiomatic: An edict selected capable officials to govern capital counties, and Xi was therefore made magistrate of Dongming.

sentences.zh: 始至，令其下曰：「吾所治者三：恃力、恃富、恃贖者，吾所先也。」

translations.literal: When he first arrived he ordered his subordinates: "What I govern are three kinds: those who rely on force, those who rely on wealth, and those who rely on bribes—I put these first."
translations.idiomatic: When he first arrived he ordered his subordinates: "What I govern are three kinds: those who rely on force, those who rely on wealth, and those who rely on bribes—I put these first."

sentences.zh: 歲中以治跡聞。

translations.literal: Within the year his governing traces were reported.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year his governing traces were reported.

sentences.zh: 樞密直學士李及薦為監察御史。

translations.literal: Direct academician in the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Ji recommended him as investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: Direct academician in the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Ji recommended him as investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 丁謂貶崖州，議還內地。

translations.literal: Ding Wei was demoted to Yazhou and the court debated returning him to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Wei was demoted to Yazhou and the court debated returning him to the interior.

sentences.zh: 錫疏謂：「姦邪弄國，本與天下共棄之；

translations.literal: Xi memorialized: "The depraved who toyed with the state were originally abandoned together with all under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: Xi memorialized: "The depraved who toyed with the state were originally abandoned together with all under Heaven;

sentences.zh: 今復還，是違天下意。」

translations.literal: to bring them back now is to go against the will of all under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: to bring them back now is to go against the will of all under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 由是止徙雷州。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was only moved to Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he was only moved to Leizhou.

sentences.zh: 玉清昭應宮災，連繫甚眾。

translations.literal: When the Yujing Zhaoying Palace burned, many were implicated in chains.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yujing Zhaoying Palace burned, many were implicated in chains.

sentences.zh: 錫言：「天災反以罪人，恐重天怒，願修德以應之。」

translations.literal: Xi said: "Heaven's disaster yet punishing men—I fear this will redouble Heaven's anger; I pray Your Majesty cultivate virtue to respond to it."
translations.idiomatic: Xi said: "Heaven's disaster yet punishing men—I fear this will redouble Heaven's anger; I pray Your Majesty cultivate virtue to respond to it."

sentences.zh: 會論者眾，獄遂解。

translations.literal: As many joined in discussion, the cases were dissolved.
translations.idiomatic: As many joined in discussion, the cases were dissolved.

sentences.zh: 遷殿中侍御史，權三司鹽鐵判官，出為荊湖北路轉運使，改尚書兵部員外郎，還判度支勾院，為京東轉運使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to palace attendant censor, acting fiscal judge in the Salt and Iron Commission, went out as transport commissioner of northern Jinghu Road, changed to outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of War, returned to judge the fiscal verification bureau, and became transport commissioner of eastern Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to palace attendant censor, acting fiscal judge in the Salt and Iron Commission, went out as transport commissioner of northern Jinghu Road, changed to outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of War, returned to judge the fiscal verification bureau, and became transport commissioner of eastern Shandong.

sentences.zh: 淄、青、齊、濮、鄆諸州人冒耕河壖地，數起爭訟。

translations.literal: In Zi, Qing, Qi, Pu, and Yan prefectures people falsely cultivated river-bank land and lawsuits arose repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In Zi, Qing, Qi, Pu, and Yan prefectures people falsely cultivated river-bank land and lawsuits arose repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 錫命籍其地，收租絹歲二十餘萬，訟者亦息。

translations.literal: Xi ordered the land registered and rent silk collected—more than two hundred thousand a year—and litigants also ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Xi ordered the land registered and rent silk collected—more than two hundred thousand a year—and litigants also ceased.

sentences.zh: 判鹽鐵勾院，為河北轉運使，改江、淮制置發運使，召兼侍御史知雜事、判大理寺、權知諫院，安撫利、夔路。

translations.literal: He judged the Salt and Iron verification bureau, became transport commissioner of Hebei, changed to commissioner for arranging transport on the Yangzi and Huai, was summoned with concurrent attendant censor knowing miscellaneous matters, judged the Court of Judicial Review, and acted as remonstrance official, pacifying Li and Kui circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He judged the Salt and Iron verification bureau, became transport commissioner of Hebei, changed to commissioner for arranging transport on the Yangzi and Huai, was summoned with concurrent attendant censor knowing miscellaneous matters, judged the Court of Judicial Review, and acted as remonstrance official, pacifying Li and Kui circuits.

sentences.zh: 歷度支、鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice commissioner of fiscal affairs and salt and iron.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as vice commissioner of fiscal affairs and salt and iron.

sentences.zh: 喪母，起復，擢天章閣待制、知河中府，累遷右司郎中，以龍圖閣直學士知滑州，遷右諫議大夫、知審官院。

translations.literal: When his mother died he was recalled from mourning, elevated to awaiting edict in the Tianzhang Pavilion and prefect of Hezhong, promoted repeatedly to director in the right bureau, and as direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion became prefect of Huazhou, then right remonstrance grandee and director of the Court for Review of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he was recalled from mourning, elevated to awaiting edict in the Tianzhang Pavilion and prefect of Hezhong, promoted repeatedly to director in the right bureau, and as direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion became prefect of Huazhou, then right remonstrance grandee and director of the Court for Review of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 進翰林侍讀學士、判太常寺、國子監。

translations.literal: He was advanced to reader-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy, judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and superintendent of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to reader-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy, judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and superintendent of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈尚書工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted Vice Director of the Ministry of Works in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted Vice Director of the Ministry of Works in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 錫淳重清約，雖貴，奉養如少賤時。

translations.literal: Xi was pure, weighty, clear, and sparing; though honored, his support of parents was as when young and lowly.
translations.idiomatic: Xi was pure, weighty, clear, and sparing; though honored, his support of parents was as when young and lowly.

sentences.zh: 讀書老而彌篤。

translations.literal: He read books and in old age was even more earnest.
translations.idiomatic: He read books and in old age was even more earnest.

sentences.zh: 初，舉廣文館進士，考官任隨以為第一，及隨死，無子，錫屢賙其家。

translations.literal: At first he entered the Guangwen Academy jinshi examination; examiner Ren Sui ranked him first, and when Sui died without sons, Xi repeatedly aided his household.
translations.idiomatic: At first he entered the Guangwen Academy jinshi examination; examiner Ren Sui ranked him first, and when Sui died without sons, Xi repeatedly aided his household.

sentences.zh: 張揆，字貫之，其先范陽人，後徙齊州。

translations.literal: Zhang Kui, style name Guanzhi, his ancestors were natives of Fanyang and later moved to Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kui, courtesy name Guanzhi, his ancestors were natives of Fanyang and later moved to Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 擢進士第，歷北海縣尉，改大理寺丞。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as aide in Beihai and was changed to aide in the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as aide in Beihai and was changed to aide in the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 以疾解官，十年不出戶。

translations.literal: On grounds of illness he resigned office and for ten years did not leave his door.
translations.idiomatic: On grounds of illness he resigned office and for ten years did not leave his door.

sentences.zh: 讀《易》，因通揚雄《太玄經》。

translations.literal: Reading the Changes, he thereby mastered Yang Xiong's Supreme Mystery.
translations.idiomatic: Reading the Changes, he thereby mastered Yang Xiong's Supreme Mystery.

sentences.zh: 陳執中安撫京東，薦揆經明行淳，召為國子監直講，徙諸王府侍講。

translations.literal: Chen Zhizhong pacified eastern Jing and recommended Kui as clear in the classics and pure in conduct; he was summoned as direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education and transferred to lecturer in the various princely establishments.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhizhong pacified eastern Jing and recommended Kui as clear in the classics and pure in conduct; he was summoned as direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education and transferred to lecturer in the various princely establishments.

sentences.zh: 以尚書度支員外郎直史館、荊王府記室參軍。

translations.literal: As outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Revenue he served as direct compiler in the Academy of History and recorder in the Jing princely establishment.
translations.idiomatic: As outer-court vice-director in the Ministry of Revenue he served as direct compiler in the Academy of History and recorder in the Jing princely establishment.

sentences.zh: 府罷，權三司戶部判官。

translations.literal: When the establishment was abolished he acted as fiscal judge in the Three Departments' Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When the establishment was abolished he acted as fiscal judge in the Three Departments' Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 上所著《太玄集解》數萬言。

translations.literal: He submitted his Collected Explanations of the Supreme Mystery in tens of thousands of words.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted his Collected Explanations of the Supreme Mystery in tens of thousands of words.

sentences.zh: 詔對邇英閣，令揲耆，得斷首，且言：「斷首準《易》之《夬》，蓋以陽剛決陰柔，君子進、小人退之象。」

translations.literal: An edict ordered audience in the Nearby Excellence Hall; he was told to cast yarrow stalks and obtained Severed Head, and said: "Severed Head corresponds to Guai in the Changes—yang firm deciding yin soft, the image of the gentleman advancing and petty men retreating."
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered audience in the Nearby Excellence Hall; he was told to cast yarrow stalks and obtained Severed Head, and said: "Severed Head corresponds to Guai in the Changes—yang firm deciding yin soft, the image of the gentleman advancing and petty men retreating."

sentences.zh: 仁宗悅。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong was pleased.

sentences.zh: 擢天章閣待制兼侍讀，累遷右諫議大夫，進龍圖閣直學士、給事中、判太常寺。

translations.literal: He was elevated to awaiting edict in the Tianzhang Pavilion with concurrent lecturer, promoted repeatedly to right remonstrance grandee, and advanced to direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, recipient of edicts, and judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was elevated to awaiting edict in the Tianzhang Pavilion with concurrent lecturer, promoted repeatedly to right remonstrance grandee, and advanced to direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, recipient of edicts, and judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 一日，進讀漢《馬后傳》，至服大練、抑止外家，因言：「今妃族太盛，不可不裁損，使保其家。」

translations.literal: One day, lecturing on the Han Empress Ma in the Veritable Records, when he came to wearing coarse silk and restraining the maternal kin, he therefore said: "Today the consort clans are too flourishing—they cannot but be cut back so their houses may be preserved."
translations.idiomatic: One day, lecturing on the Han Empress Ma in the Veritable Records, when he came to wearing coarse silk and restraining the maternal kin, he therefore said: "Today the consort clans are too flourishing—they cannot but be cut back so their houses may be preserved."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 詔改王溥諡，有議欲為「文忠」者，揆曰：「溥，周之宰相，國亡不能死，安得為忠？」

translations.literal: When an edict changed Wang Pu's posthumous title, some debated making it "Literary Loyal"; Kui said: "Pu was a Zhou chancellor who could not die when the state perished—how can he be called loyal?"
translations.idiomatic: When an edict changed Wang Pu's posthumous title, some debated making it "Literary Loyal"; Kui said: "Pu was a Zhou chancellor who could not die when the state perished—how can he be called loyal?"

sentences.zh: 乃諡為「文康」。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was given "Literary Tranquility."
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he was given "Literary Tranquility."

sentences.zh: 加翰林侍讀學士、知審刑院，出知齊州。

translations.literal: He was added reader-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy and director of the Court for Review of Punishments, and went out as prefect of Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was added reader-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy and director of the Court for Review of Punishments, and went out as prefect of Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈尚書禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously granted Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously granted Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 揆性剛狷少容，闊於世務，然好讀書，老而不倦。

translations.literal: Kui's nature was stern and narrow with little tolerance, broad in worldly affairs, yet he loved reading and in old age did not weary.
translations.idiomatic: Kui's nature was stern and narrow with little tolerance, broad in worldly affairs, yet he loved reading and in old age did not weary.

sentences.zh: 與弟掞相友愛，掞，為龍圖閣直學士。

translations.literal: He and his younger brother Shan loved each other; Shan became direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He and his younger brother Shan loved each other; Shan became direct academician in the Dragon Diagram Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 楊安國

translations.literal: Yang Anguo
translations.idiomatic: Yang Anguo

sentences.zh: 楊安國，字君倚，密州安丘人。

translations.literal: Yang Anguo, style name Junyi, was a native of Anqiu in Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Anguo, courtesy name Junyi, was a native of Anqiu in Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 父光輔，居馬耆山，學者多從受經，州守王博文薦為太學助教。

translations.literal: His father Guangfu dwelt on Maqi Mountain; many students followed him to receive the classics; prefect Wang Bowen recommended him as teaching aide in the Imperial College.
translations.idiomatic: His father Guangfu dwelt on Maqi Mountain; many students followed him to receive the classics; prefect Wang Bowen recommended him as teaching aide in the Imperial College.

sentences.zh: 孫奭知兗州，又薦為太常寺奉禮郎，州學講書。

translations.literal: When Sun Shi knew Yanzhou he again recommended him as ceremonial officer in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and lecturer in the prefectural school.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun Shi knew Yanzhou he again recommended him as ceremonial officer in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and lecturer in the prefectural school.

sentences.zh: 既而奭與馮元薦安國為國子監直講，並召光輔至。

translations.literal: Thereafter Shi with Feng Yuan recommended Anguo as direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education and summoned Guangfu as well.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Shi with Feng Yuan recommended Anguo as direct lecturer in the Directorate of Education and summoned Guangfu as well.
